object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Open VCU3-SRS and type a text that matches no object into the filter box. Expected: the grid shows the no-match state. Turn Suspects only on as well, then choose Clear filters. Expected: the filter box is empty, Suspects only is off, and the grid shows its rows again.
